items.reason: Gap 0 explicitly describes overlapping retries both passing the deduplication check before recording and running the credit handler twice.
Gap 1 states that the deduplication key comes from X-Event-Id and that this header is an unsigned convenience copy.
Gap 2 says the provider sends charge.refunded while the handler is registered as refund.created, causing refunds to be swallowed.
No gap relies on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
